title: Compare Jackson trailing-dot syntax through four public Databind consumers
description: Isolate the complete unmodified 2.17.1 and 2.17.2 classpaths for the JVM oracle, compare their symbolic copies, then check the predicate change and typed ObjectMapper partition including raw negative-zero bits, decimal scale and exact exception class.
